chapters.text: A new housing law lands on your desk. Which buildings need your attention? This is LawDiff.
Move New Jersey’s FAIR Act past its effective date. The workspace reveals where missing property facts need a closer look.
Open one address. See the requirement, its timing, and the original passage behind the interpretation.
Now turn that finding into a review brief. Listed addresses get their status, source, and next check.
Export the list for your compliance team: original address data, source wording, and what to review next.
Rules extracted automatically. Selected records unchanged. One traceable pack powers the workspace and submission. Inspect the chain.
